about: The offertory antiphon of the Second Sunday of Advent, from Psalm 84. The priest says the same verses at the foot of the altar at the beginning of every Mass, where they are a dialog between him and the server. Here they form one continuous petition.

s01.translation: O God, You will turn toward us and give us life, and Your people will rejoice in You. Show us Your mercy, O Lord, and grant us Your salvation.
